sections.title: Generator settings for both outputs
sections.what: Sets the React query client with the custom fetch wrapper and the base path api. Sets the zod validator with date and big-number handling and input coercion. Both use split output and clean the old files first.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the frontend and the validators working from the same description.
sections.watch_out: The clean setting deletes any manual edits in the generated folders on every run.

summary: Configuration for the code generator that turns the API description file into React data hooks and validation schemas.
purpose: Creates the client library and the validation library from one shared API description, so both stay matched.
why: The comment explains that the title must be Api, because the generated files are named after it.
how: Works out the folders for the two outputs. The title transformer sets the API title to Api. The default export configures two generators: a React query client using a custom fetch wrapper and a base path of api, and a zod validator with date and big-number support. Both write split files into cleaned output folders.
inputs: The openapi.yaml API description, and custom-fetch.ts in the client library.
outputs: Generated files in a generated folder inside each library's source folder.
risks: The clean option deletes the old generated files on each run, so hand edits there are lost. The file uses the folder name variable, which may not work if a tool loads the file as a module. This cannot be confirmed from the code alone.
debug: If generated code breaks, check that openapi.yaml is valid. If hooks are missing, check that the mutator path exists. If no output appears, run the codegen command in lib/api-spec.
